newsitem.title: SWEDEN: AGA reorganises to help profitability.
newsitem.headline: AGA reorganises to help profitability.

text.p: Swedish gas company AGA AB on Thursday said it was reorganising the company with operations to be divided into three business areas in a bid to boost profitability.
The three divisions will be manufacturing industry, process industry, and health care with each responsible for their own global profitability.
AGA said in a statement that it had also decided to increase operational efficiency and to reduce costs, both at company headquarters in Lidingo and within AGA companies in Sweden and abroad.
The company said it had also decided to make a major investment in common Information Technology within the group to improve customer service.

"Even if our market shares have continued to grow, there are reaons for examining costs, not least of all central costs, since these have increased far too mcuh over recent years," said AGA chief executive Lennart Selander in a statement.
"We expect to rapidly obtain results that will improve AGA's profitability."
